run_notes: Modal spend read from `modal billing report`: the first full run (12 containers, stopped after about 40 minutes) and a smoke run cost about 0.25 USD and left no per-fixture records (they were written only at the end); the second run (three 15 minute containers, a fourth for the rest, a Renovate rerun) about 0.17 USD against the 0.10 cap, so the total is over the cap. Untraced fixtures ran once, without strace, blocked network or write scan; the key fixtures and the `x-` projects ran traced. The 18 descriptor fixtures (`real-*`, `mix-real-*`) were cloned at the pinned commit inside the container and ran once, untraced, network open (two containers; the first stopped on a dangling symlink in a copy). Billing read at the end: 0.406 USD for the app, the last hours not fully billed yet.
